descriptionFull: The Eurasian blackcap ( Sylvia atricapilla ) usually known simply as the blackcap , is a common and widespread typical warbler. It has mainly olive-grey upperparts and pale grey underparts, and differences between the five subspecies are small. Both sexes have a neat coloured cap to the head, black in the male and reddish-brown in the female.
